actual_functions.cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256:
create function cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256(p jsonb) returns text
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select encode(pg_catalog.sha256(convert_to(p::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
$$;

$$;

actual_functions.ow04_source_proposal.financial_journal_p:
create function ow04_source_proposal.financial_journal_payload(p_journal uuid,p_ar uuid)returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path=''as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('journal_id',j.id,'source_type',j.source_type,'source_id',j.source_id,
  'reversal_of_id',j.reversal_of_id,'economic_date',j.economic_date,'transaction_date',j.transaction_date,
  'posting_at',j.posting_at,'ar_lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,
   'account_id',l.account_id,'customer_id',l.customer_id,'debit',ow04_source_proposal.cents(l.debit),
   'credit',ow04_source_proposal.cents(l.credit))order by l.id)from erp.journal_lines l
   where l.journal_entry_id=j.id and l.account_id=p_ar),'[]'))
 from erp.journal_entries j where j.id=p_journal
$$;

actual_functions.cp7_credit.assert_consumer_operation_inp:
create function cp7_credit.assert_consumer_operation_input_v1(p_operation uuid)returns void
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path=''set TimeZone='UTC'as $$
declare o cp7_credit.consumer_operations_v1;q cp7_credit.consumer_requests_v1;selection jsonb;projection jsonb;
begin
 select *into strict o from cp7_credit.consumer_operations_v1 where id=p_operation;
 select *into strict q from cp7_credit.consumer_requests_v1 where actor=o.actor and request_id=o.request_id;
 selection:=o.locked_sources->'selection';projection:=o.projection;
 perform cp7_credit.validate_consumer_payload_v1(q.payload,true);
 if q.action is distinct from q.payload->>'action'or q.action<>o.action
  or o.payload_sha256<>cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256(q.payload)
  or o.quote_sha256 is distinct from q.payload->>'quote_sha256'
  or o.locked_sources_sha256<>cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256(o.locked_sources)
  or o.source_graph_sha256<>cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256(o.source_graph)
  or o.projection_sha256<>cp7_credit.pg_jsonb_sha256(projection)
  or o.quote_sha256<>cp7_credit.consumer_quote_binding_v1(q.payload,o.locked_sources,projection)
  or q.expected_versions is distinct from projection->'expected_versions'
  or o.source_graph is distinct from o.locked_sources->'graph'
  or(o.period_snapshot,o.authority_snapshot)is distinct from(o.locked_sources->'period',o.locked_sources->'authority')
  or(o.action,o.event_kind,o.cohort_id,o.customer_id,o.source_sale_id,o.source_root_sale_id,o.source_current_leaf_id,
      o.target_sale_id,o.target_root_sale_id,o.target_current_leaf_id,o.cash_account_id,o.amount,o.restores_event_id)
   is distinct from(selection->>'action',selection->>'event_kind',(selection->>'cohort_id')::uuid,(selection->>'customer_id')::uuid,
      (selection->>'source_sale_id')::uuid,(selection->>'source_root_sale_id')::uuid,(selection->>'source_current_leaf_id')::uuid,
      (selection->>'target_sale_id')::uuid,(selection->>'target_root_sale_id')::uuid,(selection->>'target_current_leaf_id')::uuid,
      (selection->>'cash_account_id')::uuid,(selection->>'amount')::numeric,(selection->>'restores_event_id')::uuid)
  or(o.physical_at,o.economic_date,o.transaction_date,o.reason,o.reference,o.credit_account_id,o.target_ar_account_id,o.cash_coa_account_id)
   is distinct from((q.payload->>'physical_at')::timestamptz,(projection->>'economic_date')::date,(projection->>'transaction_date')::date,
      q.payload->>'reason',q.payload->>'reference',(projection#>>'{credit_account,account,id}')::uuid,
      (projection#>>'{target_ar_source,account_id}')::uuid,(projection#>>'{cash_account,account,id}')::uuid)
  or(o.credit_account_snapshot,o.target_ar_snapshot,o.cash_account_snapshot,o.book_manifest,o.before_native)is distinct from
    (projection->'credit_account',nullif(projection->'target_ar_source','null'::jsonb),nullif(projection->'cash_account','null'::jsonb),
      projection->'book_manifest',projection->'before_native')then
  raise exception 'CP7_CREDIT_CONSUMER_IMMUTABLE_INPUT_AGREEMENT_CHANGED';end if;
end $$;
actual_functions.cp7_credit.consumer_document_ar_v1:
create function cp7_credit.consumer_document_ar_v1(p_sale uuid,p_customer uuid,p_ar uuid)returns numeric
language sql stable security definer set search_path=''set TimeZone='UTC'as $$
 with recursive originals(id)as(
  select substring(v->>'id'from 9)::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(cp7_credit.initial_base_events_v1(p_sale))v
  union select cj.journal_id from cp7_credit.component_journals cj join cp7_credit.component_parts part on part.id=cj.part_id
   join cp7_credit.recognition_components component on component.id=part.component_id
   join cp7_credit.recognition_plans plan on plan.id=component.plan_id join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=plan.cohort_id
   join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id where f.family_root_sale_id=p_sale
 ),walk(id)as(select id from originals union select j.id from walk w join erp.journal_entries j
  on j.reversal_of_id=w.id or(j.source_type='JOURNAL_REVERSAL'and j.source_id=w.id))
 select coalesce(sum(l.debit-l.credit),0)from walk w join erp.journal_entries j on j.id=w.id
  join erp.journal_lines l on l.journal_entry_id=j.id where j.status in('POSTED','REVERSED')
   and l.customer_id=p_customer and l.account_id=p_ar
$$;
actual_functions.cp7_credit.consumer_outcome_v1:
create function cp7_credit.consumer_outcome_v1(p_operation uuid,p_profiles jsonb,p_capacity jsonb)returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path=''set TimeZone='UTC'as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('contract_version','cp7.customer-credit-outcome.v1','kind','COMMITTED_OUTCOME',
  'action',o.action,'event_kind',o.event_kind,'request_id',o.request_id,'operation_id',o.id,
  'consumption_event_id',o.id,'journal_id',e.journal_id,'cohort_id',o.cohort_id,'source_sale_id',o.source_sale_id,
  'target_sale_id',o.target_sale_id,'cash_account_id',o.cash_account_id,'restores_event_id',o.restores_event_id,
  'amount',cp7_credit.cent_text(o.amount),'physical_at',cp7_credit.refund_physical_text(o.physical_at),
  'economic_date',o.economic_date,'transaction_date',o.transaction_date,'available_credit',p_capacity->'current_balance',
  'invoice_versions',(select jsonb_object_agg(key,value->'row_version')from jsonb_each(p_profiles)))
 from cp7_credit.consumer_operations_v1 o join cp7_credit.consumption_events e on e.id=o.id where o.id=p_operation
$$;
actual_functions.erp._cp7_current_credit_adjustment:
create function erp._cp7_current_credit_adjustment(p_sale uuid)returns numeric
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' set TimeZone='UTC' as $$
declare h erp.sales_headers;m record;i numeric;u numeric;
begin
 select *into strict h from erp.sales_headers where id=p_sale;
 -- Preserve inactive/DRAFT document financial semantics: own Native P only.
 if h.status not in('POSTED','PARTIAL_PAID','PAID')then return 0::numeric;end if;
 select *into strict m from cp7_credit.current_leaf_assignment(p_sale);
 -- Legacy invoices/ordinary returns have no OW04 participation. Preserve the
 -- Native payment projection without inventing family order or requiring a
 -- retrofit of old posted returns. A protected journal cannot exploit this
 -- fast path: every such actual journal must have its exact retained link.
 if exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
  where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_RECOGNITION'and not exists(
   select 1 from cp7_credit.component_journals cj
    join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.id=cj.part_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.id=q.component_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.id=cc.plan_id
    join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=p.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
   where cj.journal_id=j.id and q.id=j.source_id))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
   where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_REFUND'and not exists(
    select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
     join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=e.cohort_id
     join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
    where e.journal_id=j.id and e.id=j.source_id and e.event_kind='REFUND'))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j where j.source_type in('CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY','CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE')
   and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events ce join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=ce.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id where ce.journal_id=j.id and ce.id=j.source_id
     and((j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY'and ce.event_kind='APPLY'and ce.amount>0 and ce.restores_event_id is null)
      or(j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE'and ce.amount<0 and ce.restores_event_id is not null))))then
  raise exception 'CP7_CREDIT_UNREPRESENTED_FINANCIAL_JOURNAL';end if;
 if not cp7_credit_note_carry_de.is_current_v1(p_sale)and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.return_families f where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id)
  and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
   where e.event_kind='APPLY'and cp7_credit_note_carry_de.effective_target_v1(e.id)=p_sale)then return 0::numeric;end if;
 if cp7_credit.payment_is_intermediate_v1(p_sale)then return cp7_credit.payment_intermediate_adjustment_v1(p_sale);end if;
 perform cp7_credit.assert_current_materialized_profile(p_sale,m.root_sale_id,m.current_leaf_id);
 -- Validator above proves ALL parts have actual journals; this join is not a
 -- silent filter permitting a partial pending plan to masquerade as actual I.
 select coalesce(sum(q.amount),0)into i
  from cp7_credit.return_families f join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.family_id=f.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.cohort_id=c.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.plan_id=p.id
  join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.component_id=cc.id
  join cp7_credit.component_journals j on j.part_id=q.id
  where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id;
 -- Signed restores are retained, not filtered away by amount/status. An
 -- advance-backed Native sales_payment is already P and is NOT another U.
 select coalesce(sum(e.amount),0)into u from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
  where e.event_kind='APPLY'and cp7_credit_note_carry_de.effective_target_v1(e.id)=p_sale;
 return u-i;
end $$;
